common.readOnlyBody: Sending is turned off in this version. Balances and history are live.
common.supportNeverAsks: MPC support will never ask for your recovery phrase or password.
common.failed: Something went wrong and nothing was changed. Try again.
common.networkError: The network did not answer. Check your connection and try again.

send.title: Send MPC
send.irreversible: Transfers on the blockchain cannot be reversed. Check every character of the address.
send.bnbChainOnly: Send only to an address on BNB Smart Chain.
send.waiting: Waiting for the network to confirm. You can close this window; the result shows on the home screen.
send.failedBody: The network fee was spent but the MPC did not move. Check the transaction on BscScan.
send.stillPending: Still waiting for confirmation. It shows on the home screen when it lands.

errors.shape: Enter a full address: 0x and 40 characters.
errors.checksum: This address has a typo: the letter case does not match its checksum.
errors.tokenContract: This is the MPC token contract. Tokens sent to it are lost.
errors.amountTooHigh: This is more MPC than you have.
errors.noBnb: Not enough BNB for the network fee. Add BNB to this wallet first.
errors.pendingTransfer: Your last transfer is still waiting for the network. You can send again once it settles on the home screen.
errors.feeCeiling: The network fee is unusually high right now. Try again later.
errors.wrongChain: The network connection is not BNB Smart Chain. Nothing was sent.
errors.rejected: The network refused the transfer. Nothing was sent.
errors.network: The network did not answer. Nothing was sent. Check your connection and try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.revealWarning: Anyone who sees these words can take everything in this wallet. Make sure no one is watching your screen.
settings.revealHides: The words hide again when you leave this screen.
settings.removeBody: This deletes the encrypted wallet from this browser. Your funds stay on the blockchain. Without your recovery phrase you will not be able to open this wallet again.
settings.removeCheck: I have my recovery phrase written down

send.title: MPC 보내기
send.irreversible: 블록체인 전송은 되돌릴 수 없습니다. 주소의 모든 글자를 확인하세요.
send.waiting: 네트워크 확인을 기다리는 중입니다. 이 창을 닫아도 되며, 결과는 홈 화면에 표시됩니다.
send.failedBody: 네트워크 수수료는 사용되었지만 MPC는 이동하지 않았습니다. BscScan에서 거래를 확인하세요.

errors.feeCeiling: 지금은 네트워크 수수료가 비정상적으로 높습니다. 나중에 다시 시도하세요.
errors.wrongChain: 연결된 네트워크가 BNB 스마트 체인이 아닙니다. 아무것도 보내지 않았습니다.
errors.rejected: 네트워크가 전송을 거부했습니다. 아무것도 보내지 않았습니다.
